40022741.author: पदार्थः
40022741.content: ताम् that, कथाम् story, इलसम्बद्धाम् related to Ila, रामेण by Rama, समुदीरिताम् narrated, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, भरतः Bharata, च and, एव indeed, श्रुत्वा having heard, परमविस्मितौ greatly astonished.

40022741.author: Translation
40022741.content: Having heard that story related to Ila, narrated by Rama, Lakshmana and Bharata were greatly astonished.

40022742.author: पदार्थः
40022742.content: तौ they (the two), रामं to Rama, प्राञ्जली with folded hands, भूत्वा having become, तस्य of that, राज्ञो king, महात्मनः great-souled, विस्तरं the details, तस्य of that, भावस्य state/condition, तदा then, पप्रच्छतुः asked, पुनः again.

40022742.author: Translation
40022742.content: The two, with folded hands, then again asked Rama for the detailed account of the great-souled king's condition.

40022743.author: पदार्थः
40022743.content: कथं how, स that, राजा king, स्त्रीभूतो having become a woman, वर्तयामास lived, दुर्गतिः in misfortune, पुरुषः a man, स he, यदा when, भूतः became, कां what, वृत्तिं way of life, वर्तयत्यसौ did he lead.

40022743.author: Translation
40022743.content: They inquired how that king lived in misfortune after becoming a woman, and what kind of life he led when he became a man again.

40022744.author: पदार्थः
40022744.content: तयोः of those two, तद्भाषितं their speech, श्रुत्वा having heard, कौतूहलसमन्वितम् filled with curiosity, कथयामास narrated, काकुत्स्थः Kakutstha (Rama), तस्य of that, राज्ञो king, यथागतम् as it happened.

40022744.author: Translation
40022744.content: Hearing their speech, which was full of curiosity, Rama (Kakutstha) narrated the king's story exactly as it had happened.

40022745.author: पदार्थः
40022745.content: तं that, एव very, प्रथमं first, मासं month, स्त्रीभूता having become a woman, लोकसुन्दरी beautiful in the world, ताभिः by those, परिवृता surrounded, स्त्रीभिः by women, ये who, च and, पूर्वपदानुगाः followed his former position.

40022745.author: Translation
40022745.content: For that very first month, having become a woman of unparalleled beauty, she was surrounded by the women who had previously been part of his retinue.

40022746.author: पदार्थः
40022746.content: तत्काननं that forest, विगाह्वा having entered, आशु quickly, विजह्रे roamed, लोकसुन्दरी the beautiful woman, द्रुमगुल्मलताकीर्णं filled with trees, bushes, and creepers, पद्भ्यां with her feet, पद्मदलेक्षणा lotus-petal-eyed.

40022746.author: Translation
40022746.content: The lotus-petal-eyed woman, beautiful in the world, quickly entered that forest, which was filled with trees, bushes, and creepers, and roamed through it on foot.

40022747.author: पदार्थः
40022747.content: वाहनानि conveyances, च and, सर्वाणि all, सा she, त्यक्त्वा having abandoned, वै indeed, समन्ततः all around, पर्वताभोगविवरे in the wide expanse of the mountain, तस्मिन् in that, रेमे she delighted, इला Ilā, तदा then.

40022747.author: Translation
40022747.content: Then, Ilā, having completely abandoned all her conveyances, delighted in that wide mountain cavity.

40022748.author: पदार्थः
40022748.content: अथ then, तस्मिन् in that, वनोद्देशे forest region, पर्वतस्य of the mountain, अविदूरतः not far from, सरः a lake, सुरुचिरप्रख्यं very beautiful in appearance, नानापक्षिगणैर्युतम् endowed with various flocks of birds.

40022748.author: Translation
40022748.content: Then, in that forest region not far from the mountain, there was a lake, very beautiful in appearance and filled with various flocks of birds.

40022749.author: पदार्थः
40022749.content: ददर्श she saw, सा she, तु indeed, इला Ilā, तस्मिन् in that, बुधं Budha, सोमसुतं son of Soma, तदा then, ज्वलन्तं shining, स्वेन with his own, वपुषा body, पूर्णसोममिवोदितम् like the full moon risen.

40022749.author: Translation
40022749.content: Then, Ilā saw Budha, the son of Soma, in that place, shining with his own body like the risen full moon.

40022750.author: पदार्थः
40022750.content: तपन्तं performing penance, च and, तपः penance, तीव्रम् intense, अम्भोमध्ये in the midst of water, दुरासदम् difficult to approach, यशस्करं bestowing fame, कामकरं fulfilling desires, कारुण्ये in compassion, पर्यवस्थितम् established.

40022750.author: Translation
40022750.content: He was performing intense and formidable penance in the midst of water, established in compassion, bestowing fame and fulfilling desires.

40022751.author: पदार्थः
40022751.content: सा she, तं that, जलाशयं body of water, सर्वं entire, क्षोभयामास she agitated, विस्मिता astonished, सहगैः with her companions, पूर्वपुरुषैः former men, स्त्रीभूतैः having become women, रघुनन्दन O delight of the Raghus.

40022751.author: Translation
40022751.content: O delight of the Raghus, astonished, she agitated that entire body of water along with her companions, who were formerly men but had also become women.

40022752.author: पदार्थः
40022752.content: बुधः Budha, तु but, तां her, समीक्ष्यैव having just seen, कामबाणवशं the sway of Cupid's arrows, गतः fallen into, न not, उपलेभे perceived, तदा then, आत्मानं himself, सञ्चचाल moved, तदा then, अम्भसि in the water.

40022752.author: Translation
40022752.content: But Budha, having just seen her, fell under the sway of Cupid's arrows, lost control of himself, and then stirred in the water.

40022753.author: पदार्थः
40022753.content: इलां Ila, निरीक्षमाणस्तु looking at, त्रैलोक्याभ्यधिकां superior to the three worlds, शुभाम् beautiful, चिन्तां a thought, समभ्यतिक्रामत् came to him, का who, नु indeed, इयं this, देवताधिका superior goddess.

40022753.author: Translation
40022753.content: As he gazed at Ila, who was more beautiful than anything in the three worlds, a thought came to him: "Who indeed is this superior goddess?"

40022754.author: पदार्थः
40022754.content: न not, देवीषु among goddesses, न not, नागीषु among Nāga women, न not, आसुरीषु among Asura women, अप्सरःसु among Apsaras, च and, दृष्टपूर्वा seen before, मया by me, काचित् any, रूपेण by form, अनेन by this, शोभिता adorned.

40022754.author: Translation
40022754.content: Never before have I seen anyone adorned with such beauty, neither among goddesses, Nāga women, Asura women, nor Apsaras.

40022755.author: पदार्थः
40022755.content: सदृशी suitable, इयं this (woman), मम for me, भवेत् would be, यदि if, न not, अन्यपरिग्रहः taken by another, इति thus, बुद्धिं a thought, समास्थाय having firmly resolved, जलात् from the water, कूलं to the bank, उपागमत् he went.

40022755.author: Translation
40022755.content: Having firmly resolved that she would be suitable for him if she were not already taken by another, he then went from the water to the bank.

40022756.author: पदार्थः
40022756.content: आश्रमं to the hermitage, समुपागम्य having approached, ततः then, ताः those, प्रमदोत्तमाः excellent women, शब्दापयत called out to, धर्मात्मा the righteous one, ताः they, च and, एनं him, च and, ववन्दिरे bowed down.

40022756.author: Translation
40022756.content: Having approached the hermitage, the righteous Budha then called out to those excellent women, and they, in turn, bowed down to him.

40022757.author: पदार्थः
40022757.content: सः He, ताः them, पप्रच्छ asked, धर्मात्मा the righteous one, कस्य whose, एषा is this, लोकसुन्दरी world-beautiful woman, किमर्थम् for what purpose, आगता has come, च and, एव indeed, सर्वम् everything, आख्यात tell, मा not, चिरम् delay

40022757.author: Translation
40022757.content: The righteous king asked them, "Whose is this most beautiful woman, and for what purpose has she come? Tell me everything without delay."

40022758.author: पदार्थः
40022758.content: शुभम् auspicious, तु indeed, तस्य his, तत् that, वाक्यम् speech, मधुरम् sweet, मधुराक्षरम् with sweet words, श्रुत्वा having heard, स्त्रियः women, च and, ताः those, सर्वाः all, ऊचुः spoke, मधुरया with sweet, गिरा voice

40022758.author: Translation
40022758.content: Having heard his auspicious, sweet, and melodious words, all those women replied with a sweet voice.

40022759.author: पदार्थः
40022759.content: अस्माकम् our, एषा this, सुश्रोणी beautiful-hipped woman, प्रभुत्वे in authority, वर्तते is, सदा always, अपतिः without a husband, काननान्तेषु in the forest regions, सह with, अस्माभिः us, चरति wanders, असौ she

40022759.author: Translation
40022759.content: This beautiful-hipped woman is always in authority over us; she wanders in the forest regions without a husband, accompanied by us.

40022760.author: पदार्थः
40022760.content: तत् that, वाक्यम् speech, अव्यक्तपदम् with unclear words, तासाम् of those, स्त्रीणाम् women, निशम्य having heard, च and, विद्याम् knowledge/spell, आवर्तनीम् that which causes return, पुण्याम् sacred, आवर्तयत recited, सः that, द्विजः brahmin

40022760.author: Translation
40022760.content: Having heard that speech with indistinct words from those women, that brahmin recited the sacred spell that causes return.

40022761.author: पदार्थः
40022761.content: सः He, अर्थम् the meaning, विदित्वा having known, सकलम् the entire, तस्य of that, राज्ञः king, यथागतम् as it happened, सर्वाः all, एव indeed, स्त्रियः women, ताः those, च and, बभाषे spoke, मुनिपुङ्गवः the foremost among sages

40022761.author: Translation
40022761.content: Having understood the entire situation of that king as it had occurred, the foremost among sages then spoke to all those women.

40022762.author: पदार्थः
40022762.content: अत्र here, किम्पुरुषीर्भूत्वा becoming Kimpurushis, शैलरोधसि on the mountain slope, वत्स्यथ you shall dwell, आवासस्तु but a dwelling place, गिरावस्मिन् on this mountain, शीघ्रमेव quickly indeed, विधीयताम् let it be arranged.

40022762.author: Translation
40022762.content: You shall dwell here on the mountain slope, becoming Kimpurushis, and a dwelling place on this mountain should be arranged quickly.

40022763.author: पदार्थः
40022763.content: मूलपत्रफलैः with roots, leaves, and fruits, सर्वा all (of you), वर्तयिष्यथ you shall sustain yourselves, नित्यदा always, स्त्रियः women, किम्पुरुषान्नाम named Kimpurushas, भर्तऽन् husbands, समुपलप्स्यथ you shall obtain.

40022763.author: Translation
40022763.content: All of you shall always sustain yourselves with roots, leaves, and fruits, and as women, you shall obtain husbands named Kimpurushas.

40022764.author: पदार्थः
40022764.content: ताः those, श्रुत्वा having heard, सोमपुत्रस्य of the son of Soma, वाचं the word, किम्पुरुषीकृताः having been made Kimpurushis, उपासाञ्चक्रिरे they resided near, शैलं the mountain, वध्वस्ता those women, बहुलाः many, तदा then.

40022764.author: Translation
40022764.content: Then, those many women, having been transformed into Kimpurushis upon hearing the words of Budha, the son of Soma, resided near that mountain. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे ऽष्टाशीतितमः सर्गः ।। 88 ।। Thus ends the eighty-eighth sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
